title: NuclearScience Iodine131DecayAnalysis

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed analysis of flame speed vs chamber pressure. Created comprehensive analysis including: 1) Exploratory data analysis with clustering, 2) Multiple model fits (piecewise linear, polynomial, separate linear regressions), 3) Statistical comparison of pressure regions, 4) 11 visualization figures, 5) Detailed research report with methodology, results, and discussion. Key finding: Clear transition at ~81 kPa between two regimes - strong negative linear relationship below (R²=0.96) and minimal pressure dependence above (R²=0.016). Piecewise linear model provides best overall fit (R²=0.89).
